Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with MIDI Workbench, Soulweaver Studio, native ensembles, Showmaster and MP4 concert capture. The Hide Game Performance HUD button hides the native keyboard, guitar tone selector and metronome while keeping their game windows open for playback.
Punchline: MIDI Workbench, native ensembles, concert capture and a toggle for the game's Performance HUD.
